title: Helmet Reminder Compliance by Ride Mode
dataSources: Rides (`ride:session`), charge sessions (`ride:charge`), ride exports (`ride:export`), surf forecasts (`surf:forecast`), ride incidents (`ride:incident`), segment efforts (`fitness:segment`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sports telemetry — Onewheel ride exports, legacy Boosted board logs, Surfline forecast snapshots, and Strava segment efforts — streamed to Splunk HEC via vendor exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ride:session ride_mode=* helmet_worn=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(helmet_worn="yes",1,0))) as matched by ride_mode
| eval a_helmet_worn_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_helmet_worn_pct
description: Measures the percentage of micro-mobility rides that end with a helmet worn by ride mode.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which ride mode are helping or hurting micro-mobility rides.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a helmet worn` on `ride:session` events and summarize the hit rate by `ride_mode`.
visualization: Table of ride mode with percentage of micro-mobility rides ending with a helmet worn.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how often a helmet worn happens for each ride mode so you can see where micro-mobility rides go smoothly or get stuck.
